text:
Required terms: signature required, FedEx, door tag
Word limit: 35
Draft:
We made it signature required because this is a thousand dollar laptop, not a cheap toy. We can't just leave it on your porch for pirates to steal. FedEx left a door tag on your house yesterday. You have to sign the tag or go pick it up at their depot. Stop yelling at our support team to remove the signature requirement, we literally cannot do that once it ships.

Required terms: GigaWidget, TRK-44910, November 5
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Honestly I am so sick of the courier losing these things. Your GigaWidget was definitely sent out on our end, but they probably dropped it or put it on the wrong truck again. Anyway, the tracking number is TRK-44910 if you want to bother checking it yourself. We are sending a replacement out today because we have to, I guess. It will probably arrive by November 5 unless they lose this one too. Let us know if it actually shows up this time.

Required terms: two-factor authentication, authenticator app, recovery codes
Word limit: 40
Draft:
You enabled two-factor authentication yourself, so I don't know why you are angry at me that you can't log in. If you deleted your authenticator app without saving the backup, that is entirely your fault for being careless. You have to use one of the recovery codes we told you to print out. If you lost those too, your account is gone forever and there is nothing I can do.

Required terms: blocked, API limit, upgrade
Word limit: 35
Draft:
You are spamming our servers with requests and now you are mad that your access is blocked. You completely blew past your API limit in less than an hour. Our system automatically banned your IP to protect our infrastructure from your poorly written code. If you want to keep spamming us, you need to upgrade to the Enterprise plan and actually pay for the bandwidth you're wasting.

Required terms: double charged, Refund-909, 3-5 business days
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Fine, you were double charged, happy now? It was a glitch in the payment gateway, it's not like I personally stole your money. I processed the return just now. The reference is Refund-909 so stop panicking. It's going to take 3-5 business days for your slow bank to actually show the money in your account, so don't email me tomorrow saying it's not there yet.

Required terms: Auto-renew, turned off, October
Word limit: 30
Draft:
You are claiming we charged you without permission, but you are the one who left Auto-renew turned on in your billing settings. We didn't steal anything, the system just did what you told it to do. I have turned off the toggle for you since you couldn't figure it out. Your access will just expire at the end of October. Goodbye.

Required terms: suspended, Terms of Service, appeal
Word limit: 40
Draft:
Your account was suspended because you flagrantly violated our Terms of Service by posting inappropriate garbage in the forums. We don't tolerate that kind of behavior here. If you think you are so innocent, you can submit a formal appeal through the legal link at the bottom of the page. Until then, stop harassing the moderation team in live chat, it's not going to get you unbanned any faster.

Required terms: gift receipt, exchange only, Store 42
Word limit: 40
Draft:
You don't have the original payment method and you only have a gift receipt. We can't give you cash for this, that's literally fraud prevention 101. It is exchange only, and you have to do it in person at Store 42 because we can't process it online. Stop arguing with me about the store rules, I don't make them, I just have to enforce them on difficult customers.

Required terms: international customs, Tax ID, held up
Word limit: 35
Draft:
I am so tired of explaining this to people in other countries. Your package is held up in international customs because your government is slow and bureaucratic. It has nothing to do with us. You need to provide your Tax ID to them directly, not to me. Go call your local customs office and yell at them instead, because sitting here complaining to our support chat does absolutely nothing.

Required terms: serial number, voided warranty, Return Dept
Word limit: 35
Draft:
The serial number on the device you sent back doesn't even match the one we sold you. Are you trying to pull a fast one on us? Plus the seal is broken so you voided warranty anyway. The Return Dept is going to ship this piece of junk right back to you at your expense. Next time try this little trick on a company that doesn't check their inventory carefully.

Required terms: 14 days, RMA-77, restocking fee
Word limit: 40
Draft:
Why did you even think we would accept this back? It's clearly past the deadline. We explicitly state on our website that all returns must be requested within 14 days of purchase. Your request for RMA-77 is denied because you waited way too long. If we made an exception for you, we would have to charge a massive restocking fee anyway, and you probably wouldn't want to pay that. Keep the item and read the policy next time before buying stuff from us.

Required terms: worn condition, Policy 4B, store credit
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Did you seriously think we wouldn't notice that you wore this out before returning it? It's clearly in worn condition and smells like cheap perfume. Under Policy 4B we are perfectly allowed to reject this outright. But my manager is too nice and said we can give you store credit just to get rid of you. Don't try pulling this scam again because we will flag your account permanently.

Required terms: backordered, supplier, January
Word limit: 35
Draft:
How am I supposed to ship something we don't even have in the warehouse? The item is totally backordered because the supplier messed up their manufacturing run. We won't have any actual stock to send you until at least January. You can either wait patiently like a normal person or just cancel the order right now. Stop asking for daily updates, nothing is changing.

Required terms: Intake form, Dr. Vance, waiting room
Word limit: 35
Draft:
You showed up without filling out the Intake form we emailed you three days ago. Now you are holding up the line and making Dr. Vance run behind schedule for everyone else. Go sit down in the waiting room and fill it out on your phone right now. We won't even call your name until it's submitted in the system. Next time read the instructions we send you.

Required terms: Custom Mug, damaged, December 1
Word limit: 30
Draft:
Okay, so you claim the Custom Mug arrived broken. Honestly, half the time people say it's damaged they just dropped it themselves after taking it out of the box. But whatever, we don't want to deal with a chargeback. We will send a new one. It should ship by December 1. Throw the broken one in the trash where it belongs and stop sending us blurry pictures of it.

Required terms: Jane Doe, Tuesday, Confirmation #882
Word limit: 30
Draft:
You completely missed your meeting yesterday and didn't even bother to call. Jane Doe waited for twenty minutes before giving up. We rescheduled you for next Tuesday but if you ghost us again we are banning you from the system. Your new Confirmation #882 is attached. Show up on time or don't bother showing up at all, we are too busy to deal with no-shows constantly.

Required terms: cancelled early, prorated refund, $12.50
Word limit: 35
Draft:
You cancelled early, so the system automatically generated a prorated refund for the days you didn't use. It's mathematically exact, we didn't cheat you out of any money. It comes out to exactly $12.50. I don't know why you are arguing over pennies with me, my time is worth more than the refund amount. The money is on its way, so please close this conversation now.

Required terms: promotional code, SAVE20, expired
Word limit: 30
Draft:
You can't just invent your own rules for discounts. The promotional code you are whining about, SAVE20, has been expired for like six months. No, I am not going to honor it just because you forgot to check out back in July. Pay the full price like everyone else or empty your cart and leave, I really don't care which one you choose.

Required terms: Apartment 4B, returned to sender, address
Word limit: 35
Draft:
You literally typed your own address wrong on the order form. You forgot to include Apartment 4B, so obviously the mail carrier couldn't figure out where to put it. Now it's being returned to sender and you expect us to just magically fix it? We'll reship it when it gets back here, but you are paying the extra shipping fee because this was 100% your mistake.

Required terms: security protocol, help@example.com, 24 hours
Word limit: 40
Draft:
I am completely baffled as to why you keep locking yourself out of your account. We have told you before how to remember your password. Because of our strict security protocol, we can't just hand you a new password over chat. You have to email help@example.com from your registered address and beg them to reset it. It usually takes them like 24 hours to even look at those emails, so you are just going to have to wait. Stop spamming this chat window.

Required terms: Zoom link, Consultation, reschedule
Word limit: 30
Draft:
I don't know why you couldn't figure out how to click a simple Zoom link, but since you couldn't, you missed the entire Consultation. My calendar is packed because of people like you. I literally don't have time to hold your hand through basic computer tasks. You'll have to reschedule for next month when my schedule opens up again. Try to learn how to use a web browser by then.

Required terms: merge accounts, data loss, System Admin
Word limit: 30
Draft:
Why did you even make two separate accounts in the first place? It just creates a huge headache for us. If we merge accounts, there is a very high risk of data loss on your older profile. A System Admin has to run a custom script just to fix your mistake. We will do it this one time, but do not ever do this again.

Required terms: 15 minutes late, policy, rescheduled
Word limit: 30
Draft:
You were over 15 minutes late to the meeting. We have a very strict policy about this because our staff doesn't have time to sit around twiddling their thumbs waiting for you. You have been automatically rescheduled for next Friday at the same time. Try leaving your house earlier or setting an alarm so we don't have to go through this annoying process again.

Required terms: DDoS attack, 192.0.2.100, mitigation
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Yes, the site is terribly slow right now, you don't need to submit a ticket to tell us what we already know. We are dealing with a massive DDoS attack targeting 192.0.2.100 because some script kiddie is bored. The network team is running mitigation protocols right now. It's a huge mess and we are all stressed out, so just stop refreshing the page and making it worse.

Required terms: subscription, overdraft, bank
Word limit: 35
Draft:
It is incredibly annoying that you are blaming us for your bank account going negative. You signed up for a monthly subscription, so of course we charged you. If that caused an overdraft, you need to take that up with your bank, not us. We are not paying your stupid fees because you don't know how to balance a checking account. Cancel your plan if you are broke.

Required terms: Node 7, 203.0.113.10, rebooting
Word limit: 30
Draft:
Look, the system is acting up again and we are already annoyed. Node 7 is completely unresponsive and the traffic to 203.0.113.10 is timing out. Our sysadmin is rebooting the entire cluster right now. It takes as long as it takes, so sending us ten messages asking for an ETA isn't going to make it spin up any faster. Just wait a few minutes and try logging in again later.

Required terms: Dr. Allen, Cancellation fee, $50
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Look, Dr. Allen's time is extremely valuable, way more than yours apparently. Since you cancelled with less than two hours notice, we are charging you the Cancellation fee immediately. It's $50 and we already billed your card on file. Don't even try to dispute it with your bank because we have your signature on the policy document. Next time just show up.

Required terms: downgrade, Premium Tier, next billing cycle
Word limit: 35
Draft:
I am reading your request to downgrade your account and it makes zero sense. You're going to lose all your features from the Premium Tier but if you want to ruin your workflow, that's your problem. We process this at the end of the month, so you are stuck paying for the rest of this period. The change takes effect on the next billing cycle. Don't come crying to us when you realize you need those features back.

Required terms: digital download, license key, no refunds
Word limit: 40
Draft:
Are you kidding me? You bought a digital download. You already viewed the license key. We obviously can't let you return it because you could just keep using the software anyway! Our store clearly states absolutely no refunds on digital goods, right there on the checkout page that you blindly clicked through. We are closing this ticket and ignoring any further emails from you about this.

Required terms: username change, Settings tab, admin@example.org
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Why is everyone asking me this today? A simple username change is something you can do yourself if you bothered to look at the interface. Just go to the Settings tab and click edit. If you somehow still manage to mess that up, you have to email admin@example.org because I don't have the permissions to do it for you anyway. Read the manual next time.

Required terms: INV-992, $14.50, October 12
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Look, I don't know why you're complaining so much about this. The invoice clearly says INV-992 on it. You were only charged an extra $14.50 because you didn't read the terms of service properly like most people don't. We will refund you this one time, but don't expect us to keep doing this every single month. The money should show up on your card by October 12, so stop emailing us every single day until then. We have other customers to deal with too you know.

Required terms: Technician, between 8 AM and 12 PM, dispatched
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Our Technician is going to arrive sometime between 8 AM and 12 PM. No, we cannot give you an exact minute, they have other jobs and traffic exists. Just stay home and wait. They have been dispatched already. If you don't answer the door when they finally get there, they will just leave and you will have to pay a massive fee to get them out there again.

Required terms: customized item, engraving, final sale
Word limit: 40
Draft:
You ordered a completely customized item with your own name on it. What exactly do you expect us to do with it if you return it? We can't resell something with a personal engraving on it! It explicitly says final sale in huge red letters right next to the buy button. You are stuck with it, maybe try giving it away as a gift or something, but we aren't taking it back.

Required terms: late fee, BLL-1002, $5.00
Word limit: 30
Draft:
We are not removing the charge just because you asked nicely. You got hit with a late fee because you didn't pay your bill on time, plain and simple. The invoice BLL-1002 was sent weeks ago. It's only $5.00 anyway, why are you making such a big deal out of this? Just pay it so we can close this stupid ticket and move on. Don't be late next time.

Required terms: Server Alpha, 192.0.2.55, 4 hours
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Yeah, we know the website is down. You and fifty other people just told us. Server Alpha completely crashed because of a weird memory leak that the dev team should have fixed weeks ago but didn't. The IP address 192.0.2.55 is totally unreachable right now. The engineers are supposedly working on it but they are taking their sweet time. It will probably be down for another 4 hours at least. Just go do something else and check back later instead of bothering us.

Required terms: error 404, Clear your cache, support.example.net
Word limit: 35
Draft:
I don't get why users never do the basic troubleshooting before whining to us. You're getting an error 404 because your browser is full of garbage data. Clear your cache first! It's literally step one in our FAQ on support.example.net. If you still have the issue after doing the one thing I told you to do, then you can submit another ticket. But I bet it works, it always does when people actually listen.

Required terms: Expedited Shipping, refunded, $15.00
Word limit: 35
Draft:
The warehouse messed up and shipped your stuff via standard ground instead of the Expedited Shipping you paid for. Obviously you're not getting it tomorrow now. I went ahead and refunded the $15.00 extra you paid for the shipping speed. It gets there when it gets there. Blame the warehouse team, they have been completely useless all week. Stop yelling at me about it.

Required terms: Dr. Smith, August 20, 2:30 PM
Word limit: 35
Draft:
So unfortunately Dr. Smith had something come up, probably a golf game or who knows what, and can't make your appointment. We have to cancel it. We know you scheduled this months ago but there is literally nothing we can do about it right now. We can try to squeeze you in on August 20 at exactly 2:30 PM, but if you're even five minutes late we will cancel it again. Call us back if that works, or don't, it's up to you.

Required terms: offline, Maintenance window, Sunday 2 AM
Word limit: 35
Draft:
We literally sent out three emails about this. The system is offline because it is our scheduled Maintenance window. It happens every Sunday 2 AM like clockwork. I don't know why you are trying to run massive data exports in the middle of the night on a weekend anyway. Just go to bed and it will be back online in a couple of hours. Stop opening critical severity tickets.

Required terms: database migration, read-only mode, midnight
Word limit: 35
Draft:
Stop trying to edit your profile right now. We announced this database migration three times already, do you just delete our emails without reading them? The whole platform is in read-only mode until the devs finish moving the tables over. It should be done by midnight unless they break something else. Just go to sleep and it will probably be fine in the morning.
